long_biography.plain_text:
The transition from Lindy Dennis Industries to LDI Mechanical began with Lloyd Smith, an apprentice who eventually purchased his employer. An industry report later identified Robert as one of Lloyd's sons and an executive within the resulting HVAC organisation. Robert subsequently served as senior vice president before joining Lloyd and Mike in ownership.

As president and chief executive, Smith now directs a business built around the systems hidden inside large buildings. Its teams integrate engineering drawings, factory-made sheet metal and components, site installation and ongoing service. That operating model supports apartment and commercial projects across several western states. Lloyd remains owner-chairman and Mike owner-chief operating officer, preserving a shared family leadership structure.
